JKSSB Faces Protests Over Alleged FAA Exam Cheating

The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) is facing protests and criticism following allegations of a cheating racket in the Financial Accounts Assistant (FAA) exam. In response to the paper leak allegations, the JKSSB has announced plans to implement tighter security measures for upcoming examinations.
